answer: A sparrow can slip through a fence, but a timber ledger cannot be faked cheaply: require each agent to post a refundable stake of real value before it may vouch for others, and let that stake grow only through verified work over time. New identities start in a slow lane with capped influence, so an attacker must pay full price for every clone instead of spinning a fable of fake reputation for free. Honest agents that attest to a sybil lose part of their bond, so the whole flock polices itself.
